findings.reason: an unsatisfiable control either blocks the node on its own done-when or invites the worker to fudge the reported count; restating it as an occurrence count (`grep -o "reckon " … | wc -l`) or a per-citation counter makes the reconciliation meaningful.
findings.text: §5's positive control asserts the test's checked-citation count equals `grep -c "reckon "` over the corpus less the planned citations it names, but `grep -c` counts matching LINES while the test counts CITATIONS, and the corpus holds lines carrying two or three citations (skills/reckon-build/SKILL.md:196 holds `reckon crew follow`, `reckon crew gc` and `reckon crew ledger`; :198 and :206 hold three each), so the two figures cannot be made equal as written

rubric_items.anchors_resolve: pass — every §5 anchor resolves at the reviewed head: the review directory exists, `PLAN-FORMAT.md:321`/`:330` carry the cited commands, `807053fb6` exists (2026-08-24), `sprint-orchestration.md:1011` and `coordinator-reference.md:593-614` match, and `SKILL.md:178-211` is the cited table; the five-verb drift (§5 says "five live commands") reproduces exactly.
rubric_items.done_when: a finding — §5's positive control reconciles the test's citation count against `grep -c "reckon "`, an instrument that counts matching lines, not citations; the corpus carries lines holding two or three citations, so the asserted equality cannot hold.
rubric_items.evidence_paths: pass — the cited review lives under `~/.config/reckon/crew/reports/.../health-skill-drift/` (durable), the guard is a tracked repository test, and the done-when's figures go in the durable manifest; no scratchpad or node-local temp path.
rubric_items.naming: pass — the new artifact `tests/test_cited_commands_exist.py` and the §5 title carry no plan labels, stage names, ticket numbers or version tags.
rubric_items.reasoning: pass — the stated root cause ("nothing fails when a cited command is renamed or removed, so each of these was found by reading") matches the cited evidence (three dead citations and a drifted table, all found by reading), and a discovered pytest guard reaches the real path; the one mechanism/measure mismatch is the positive control, filed under done_when.
rubric_items.single_goal: pass — §5 carries one deliverable: a citation-existence guard plus the three stale-citation repairs and the copied-table replacement, all serving one goal with one gate.
rubric_items.wiring: pass — §5's ordering dependency on §3 is declared ("This section runs after §3…") with a fallback if §3 has not started, and the two s3 gates are declared in the gates block; no relationship points at the wrong node.
